p1_auto_enumeration.discovery_mechanism: Injectable BalancerV2PoolSource abstraction. Default SubgraphBalancerV2PoolSource is env-configured per chain (ARBICORE_BALANCER_SUBGRAPH_URL_<CHAIN>, optional ARBICORE_BALANCER_SUBGRAPH_API_KEY) — no endpoint/credential hardcoded; fails closed to DISCOVERY_UNAVAILABLE when unconfigured/erroring. Discovery is CANDIDATE-ONLY: every candidate is re-validated on-chain through the frozen P0 discover_and_quote() before it can quote. UNKNOWN/unavailable is never collapsed to zero.

balancer_v2_onchain_pool_registered.mechanism: read-only eth_getLogs of Vault PoolRegistered(bytes32,address,uint8); bounded/chunked block ranges; poolId-embeds-address + canonical-Vault-emitter guards; candidate-only.
balancer_v2_onchain_pool_registered.config: canonical RPC (ARBICORE_RPC_URL_<CHAIN>); optional ARBICORE_BALANCER_DISCOVERY_WINDOW_BLOCKS, ARBICORE_BALANCER_DISCOVERY_CHUNK_SIZE, ARBICORE_BALANCER_DISCOVERY_FROM_BLOCK_<CHAIN>. NO API key.
balancer_v2_onchain_pool_registered.note: No external credential required — removes the subgraph auth dependency. Mocked tests only; live eth_getLogs pending Codex/VPS.

known_limitations: Subgraph source REQUIRES explicit per-chain URL config; without it that source is DISCOVERY_UNAVAILABLE (fail-closed), not zero. The on-chain PoolRegistered source needs no API key (uses canonical RPC).
On-chain source default window is bounded (recent ARBICORE_BALANCER_DISCOVERY_WINDOW_BLOCKS); full-history discovery requires an explicit from_block/to_block via discover_candidates().
Any RPC/rate-limit error during eth_getLogs fails the whole discovery closed as DISCOVERY_UNAVAILABLE (no silent partial results).
Evidence is Emergent mocked/offline only — NO real five-chain live enumeration evidence. live_validation_status stays NONE until Codex validates.

GENERIC_DEX.description: Buy on venue A, sell on venue B (2-venue, single-hop each) same-token atomic cycle. Read-only evaluator that composes validated building blocks only: QuoterRegistry (UniV3 + Balancer V2) exact-size quotes, H05 USD price + registry decimals for exact-size borrow, flash-fee catalog, and FlashLoanEconomicsAssessor (aggregate_economics) for the net-profit gate.

fail_closed.unknown_liquidity: leg quote fails (LEG1/LEG2_QUOTE_FAILED) or UNKNOWN_LIQUIDITY when pool-TVL gate enabled

gas_integration.input: RouteQuote.aggregate_gas_estimate_units from BOTH legs (DEX-quote gas, NOT a full execution-tx estimate). Both legs must be status=ok AND both aggregates non-None; combined only when both known; None never treated as zero.
gas_integration.pricing: canonical all_in_cost(); gas-only USD = l1_fee_usd + l2_fee_usd (flash fee + slippage stay with the economics assessor). Native-token USD from the existing canonical price source on the registry-sourced wrapped-native address. Model None / native price None / all_in_cost None => UNKNOWN_GAS.
gas_integration.overrides: explicit gas_cost_usd or gas_estimator honored as caller overrides; otherwise canonical route-gas path.

evidence.note: Net-profit math is the REAL FlashLoanEconomicsAssessor; gas priced via the canonical ChainGasModel seam (fake model in tests; real seam exercised for all six chains). Mocked/offline only — NO live evidence.
